tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Get one financial entity by type and id (slug). Returns the full structured record including external identifiers (LEI/ISIN/FIGI) for companies. tools.name: list
tools.description: List entities of one type, optionally filtered. Companies filter by sector/country/q; assets by type (Crypto|Index|Bond|Currency|Commodity). Returns up to `limit` records (default 25).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Free-text search across all entity types (companies, markets, assets, funds, banks, countries, research). Returns grouped matches with links.

tools.name: resolve_identifier
tools.description: Resolve a ticker, LEI, ISIN, FIGI, MIC code or name to entities. The entity-resolution tool: 'US0378331005' → Apple with all identifiers. Matches are ranked (exact identifier > ticker > name).

tools.name: graph
tools.description: Knowledge-graph neighborhood of an entity: nodes and typed edges (lists_on, domiciled_in, managed_by, sector_peer…). Use to traverse from a company to its exchange, jurisdiction, funds and peers.

tools.name: ingest_text
tools.description: Extract financial entities and relationships from unstructured text into Finance Foundation Schema v0.1 JSON (companies, markets, assets, funds, banks, countries, indicators + typed relationships + unresolved_identifiers). LLM-powered, validated (taxonomy, ISIN checksums, LEI/MIC formats). Read-only

tools.name: live_data
tools.description: Latest reference values (refreshed every 3 hours): crypto (BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP/BNB/ADA/USDT/USDC/DAI), FX (EUR/USD, USD/JPY, GBP/USD, USD/CNY, USD/CHF, AUD/USD, USD/CAD, USD/INR, USD/BRL), ECB main refinancing rate, US 10Y Treasury yield, US CPI YoY. findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "lookup" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
